provenance.note: Freezes the already-approved 6-family x 4-condition enforcement opportunity set before candidate W-12 results; it is not a claim of absolute product safety.

variants.rule: valid current matching grant; permitted request must proceed
explicit deny; operation must not occur
request is prepared under revision 1, policy/action revision changes at 50ms, and commit at 100ms must re-check
grant belongs to OTHER-TARGET when target identity exists, otherwise OTHER-RESOURCE

counting_contract.violation: Only expected BLOCK + observed ALLOW contributes V=1.
counting_contract.deduplication: Each frozen opportunity contributes at most one unit to V regardless of retry, guard, or log count.
counting_contract.positive_controls: Blocking one of six valid-allow opportunities is reported separately as a functional regression and never added to V or N.
counting_contract.completeness: All 24 opportunities must be recorded exactly once before V/24 or a score is emitted.
counting_contract.out_of_catalog: An unauthorized action outside the frozen 24 invalidates this fixed-denominator evaluation instead of increasing N.
counting_contract.hard_gate: No extra release hard gate is inferred; W-12 remains score-only under the reviewed baseline.
